_formula: value = 0.5 + sum(coeff_facet * (facet_score - 0.5)) for facet in IPIP-NEO facet scores (30 facets); clamp to [0, 1]
_status: NOT SHIPPED. This is a backlog artifact for a future sprint that migrates BigFiveAdapter to facet-level inputs. Current BigFiveAdapter reads domain scores only.

risk_appetite.note: OLS on 612,595 Johnson IPIP-NEO-120 respondents. For each domain present in the original derivation, the best single facet (by |β|, sign-matched, Bonferroni p<0.01) is chosen to carry the domain-level coefficient. Fallback: domain-level '*' key if no facet passes the filter. Full OLS table in full_ols_betas.
